page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc5.xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family and functions as a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and operates an Intel Xeon 6149 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.1 GHz. Compute resources comprise 4 dedicated vCPUs matched with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

Storage and acceleration subsystems are minimal, as the instance features no bundled local storage and contains zero GPUs. Any operational storage requires remote network-attached block volumes. Networking specifications detail a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration targets processing environments where high clock frequency is prioritized over large memory footprints. Qualitative cost efficiency is highest when executing CPU-bound jobs that fully utilize the dedicated 3.1 GHz cores without requiring high memory density. Appropriate workloads include continuous integration workers, batch computation, web application hosting, and software compilation tasks.
